children: Truist Securities lowered its price target on UiPath

, the enterprise automation software company, to $14 from $17 while keeping a Hold rating, citing sector volatility and multiple compression. UiPath shares were down 1.28% intraday, as of 9:50 a.m. ET.

The cut followed UiPath's Investor Day in Las Vegas, where Truist said it gained more clarity on the product roadmap, the company's push into regulated industries and its monetization framework. Management pointed to internal use of AI as a source of cost savings but didn't update any financial targets.

Truist said it'll maintain its Hold until it has more conviction on whether growth is reaccelerating and on the eventual mix of deterministic versus probabilistic workflows. That caution follows a solid second quarter, when revenue rose 13% to $410 million and beat estimates by about $12 million.

title: Truist Trims UiPath Target After Investor Day Skips New Goals
